column1: # The COSMIC files the session's com.system76.CosmicSettings.Shortcuts/v1/
# directory replaces in the session, as the pinned closure installs them.
# cosmic-config takes a configuration's defaults from one directory, so the
# session's copy hides any later change System76 makes to these files: when
# the installed file's SHA-256 differs from the one here, the session's copy
# must be compared with the new upstream file and brought up to date, and
# ticket 204's closure check). Fields are tab-separated.
